description.value: A boutique family-run winery in the heart of the Naramata Bench, founded in 2005 by Judy Kingston and now operated with her daughter Katie as head winemaker. The property features a wine shop with tastings, plus an on-site bistro called Terroir Kitchen offering seasonal, locally-sourced food paired with their estate wines. Named BC Winery of the Year and known for small-lot reds including Syrah, Merlot, and Pinot Noir.
